headline: Caterpillar Tops Third-Quarter Profit Estimates and Maintains Annual Target
summary: Heavy equipment manufacturer Caterpillar beat quarterly profit expectations and maintained its full-year sales and margin growth forecasts.
why: Caterpillar Inc. is a leading global producer of construction and mining machinery, often viewed as a barometer for industrial spending.

impacts.name: Caterpillar Inc.
impacts.why: Beating earnings estimates and reaffirming full-year targets strengthens equity valuation.

why_moved: Stronger profitability and maintained guidance reassure investors regarding industrial and infrastructure demand across global markets.
